actions.title: Design and prove a unified workspace timeline
actions.why: Helps the operator see, across several agent tools and projects, what work is happening, without holding it all in mind.
actions.done_when: A written design exists, and a read-only timeline command shows events from live data with filters and a follow mode, with tests on fixtures.

actions.title: Stack serial Action pull requests on their predecessors
actions.why: Keeps each later Action's pull request diff and its QA plan aligned with the work it builds on.
actions.done_when: Each serial Action's draft pull request is based on the previous candidate branch, and the three-Action fast harness chain integrates all three.

actions.title: Surface and recover stalled completions
actions.why: Stops an Action from stalling silently when a pending decision or leftover agent work blocks completion.
actions.done_when: A pending Ask gate appears once in production status, and the two stall cases are recovered or stop on one named visible entry, proven in the fast harness.

actions.title: Build one parameterised script set for an N-Action rehearsal chain
actions.why: Lets run 6 and a later overnight run of nine Actions use the same reviewed steps, rather than separate hand-written scripts.
actions.done_when: One script set takes a parameter file with N from 3 to 12, its dry run prints the planned fixture change without writing, and its offline unit tests pass.

actions.title: Reword check steps in the QA plan
actions.why: Stops QA plan steps from asking reviewers to judge things they cannot verify by inspection.
actions.done_when: Checks that depend on a validation command render as inspection steps pointing to that command, and the real QA reviewer finds no QA plan issue in two verdicts.

actions.title: Add a nine-Action chain to the fast harness
actions.why: Tests the lifecycle over a longer chain and over a mid-chain blocker, where defects are more likely to appear.
actions.done_when: A nine-Action serial chain passes through the fast harness, and a mid-chain failure or expired grant stops the chain with one named, visible entry.

actions.title: Set run 6 to a nine-Action chain
actions.why: Makes the sixth rehearsal test the longer chain and makes its shutdown rely on the receipt that actually activated.
actions.done_when: The run-6 parameter file declares nine Actions, generated scripts show no drift, and a later refused grant attempt does not change the shutdown's basis.

actions.title: Compare chain Action sets regardless of order
actions.why: Stops a correct set of Actions from being refused only because it is listed in a different order.
actions.done_when: A grant preview with the same nine Actions in a different order passes, while missing, extra or duplicated Actions are still refused, pinned by tests.

actions.title: Rerun harmless non-pass verdicts a bounded number of times
actions.why: Avoids stopping on reviewer noise, while keeping retries few and visible.
actions.done_when: A verdict with no real defect is rerun up to two times with each rerun shown, and an exhausted bound produces one clear independent-verdict failure entry.

actions.title: Prepare the run-7 chain from run-6 receipts
actions.why: Lets run 7 start from the exact results of run 6 rather than from memory, reducing setup mistakes.
actions.done_when: The run-7 parameter file binds run 6's receipts, the reset positions new Actions in queue order, and a failed Codex capacity read is reported by name.

actions.title: Keep the chain fixture wording consistent with its size
actions.why: Stops the fixture from describing a different number of Actions than the run actually has.
actions.done_when: The reset renders wording that matches N, a coherence guard refuses any mismatched count, and the run-8 parameter file binds run 7's receipts.

actions.title: Record rehearsal findings and a handoff
actions.why: Lets a fresh session pick up the rehearsal from the runbook alone, and keeps lessons from repeating.
actions.done_when: The runbook has a findings ledger and a handoff section with current state and ranked next-run recommendations, and the reviewer smoke harness is preserved with a README.

actions.title: Make the done settlement name its completion request
actions.why: Stops a completed Action's next step from reading as an open instruction to a later reader.
actions.done_when: A completed Action's next step names its completion request id, pending Actions are unchanged, and the fast harness passes.

actions.title: Keep unchanged baseline symlinks during preservation
actions.why: Stops preservation from failing on symlinks that were never changed, while still refusing changed or escaping links.
actions.done_when: Unchanged tracked symlinks are preserved from Git without being followed, changed or escaping symlinks are still refused, and the focused tests and fast-rehearsal pass.

actions.title: Generate a neutral rehearsal dry preparation from one parameter file
actions.why: Makes the next rehearsal's setup reproducible and checkable offline, before any fixture change or paid call.
actions.done_when: One resumable command renders a fresh N=3 baseline and a dry proof from one parameter file, and refuses on drift, with a receipt stating the next step and the authority it needs.
